value.rationale: The fixed half-grid bound is an all-input exact variable-elimination theorem for a natural non-expansive fuzzy logic, with a uniform finite witness set and an optimal numerical-precision guarantee independent of formula depth and number of eliminated variables. The sharpness family demonstrates why the input constant grid cannot suffice. This is structurally motivated by real-valued uniform interpolation and goes beyond a routine numerical example; it does not claim a new modal interpolation-existence theorem.
